story: A seven-man breakaway formed after 10 km and built a lead of up to 2.5 minutes during a calm but fast race. The peloton gradually reeled them in near the finish, despite a few late attacks. The stage concluded in a bunch sprint, won by Ethan Vernon ahead of Erlend Blikra and Noah Hobbs.
